## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- claim-2 and claim-3 are conditional on the standard box presentation and Schur-span description of \(J_v\); they are not externally source-grounded here.
- The hook congruence should explicitly note that dual Jacobi–Trudi expansion along the first row has final cofactor \(1\), while every earlier cofactor has positive degree and hence lies in \(A_+J_v\).
- The argument covers exactly \(b=1\); it yields no extension to \(b>1\).
